Allowed Result values: `PASS` / `REQUIRES_REVISION` / `REGRESSION` / `BLOCKED` / `NOT_APPLICABLE`

## 3.1 Pre-lock architecture alternatives — REQUIRED for new Story or Founder-authorized MAJOR REMEDIATION

Do not draft three complete Lv1–Lv10 packages. Submit three genuinely different architectures before Lv1.

| Architecture | Protagonist | Relationship | Goal / Stakes | Conflict | Choice | Cost | Climax | Ending | Story Shape | Memory Moment | Place causality | Decision |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  | SELECT / REJECT |
| B |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  | SELECT / REJECT |
| C |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  | SELECT / REJECT |

```text
Selected architecture:
Why strongest:
Why A/B/C are genuinely structurally different:
Why rejected alternatives are weaker / less human / less place-causal / less distinct:
Result:
Evidence Level:
```

Three variants of `student completes project` or `first attempt fails then better method succeeds` do not satisfy this requirement.

### 5.1 Normalized semantic Difference Matrix — MACHINE gate REQUIRED for Gold candidates

Free-form difference prose cannot establish semantic independence. Populate this row for **every approved Gold reference** using the canonical normalized fingerprint registry in `app/lib/data/journey_semantic_fingerprint_catalog.dart`.

| Reference Journey | Dramatic engine match | Opening match | Conflict match | Choice match | Climax match | Consequence match | Transformation match | Ending match | Relationship geometry match | Cultural-anchor-function match | CORE match count | Secondary matches | Rule A | Rule B | Collision result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
|  | YES / NO | YES / NO | YES / NO | YES / NO | YES / NO | YES / NO | YES / NO | YES / NO | YES / NO | YES / NO |  |  | PASS / COLLISION | PASS / COLLISION | `BLOCKED` |

Binding thresholds:

- Rule A: same `dramaticEngineFamily` + at least **3 additional CORE matches** = semantic collision.
- Rule B: at least **4 CORE matches** = semantic collision, even when dramatic-engine labels differ.
- A NEW Gold candidate with any semantic collision MUST record `TEMPLATE COLLISION - NOT GOLD READY` and `Next phase authorized: NO`.
- Existing approved Gold-to-Gold collisions are recorded as `EXISTING_SEMANTIC_COLLISION_DEBT`; they MUST NOT be silently allowlisted or used as precedent for a new Gold candidate.
- Exact active Story evidence is required for every CORE semantic classification.
- `Rule A = 0` and `Rule B = 0` mean only `MACHINE SEMANTIC COLLISION = PASS`; they do not establish human Story differentiation.

### 5.2 De-skinned Story Spine — HUMAN gate REQUIRED for Gold candidates

Remove city, attraction, character names, profession, academic/specialist labels, specific cultural nouns, and named props. Record only:

```text
WHO WANTS WHAT:
WHY IT MATTERS:
WHAT BLOCKS THEM:
RELATIONSHIP PRESSURE:
WHAT FAILS:
WHAT MUST BE CHOSEN:
WHAT THE CHOICE COSTS:
CLIMAX:
IRREVERSIBLE RESULT:
HOW THE PERSON CHANGES:
FINAL ACTION:
STORY SHAPE:
MEMORY MOMENT:
```

Then compare against **every current Founder-approved Gold Story**.

| Approved Gold Journey | Shared de-skinned spine | Story Shape similarity | Relationship similarity | Opening similarity | Climax similarity | Ending similarity | Memory Moment similarity | Emotional texture similarity | Human collision result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  | PASS / FAIL |

If two Stories remain highly similar after de-skinning, record `HUMAN STORY COLLISION — NOT GOLD READY` even when machine Rule A and Rule B pass.

The following recurring structure is a mandatory red flag:

`student assignment → first version fails → peer raises question/tests → protagonist re-observes place → redesigns artifact → peer validates second version → method succeeds → method is carried into next project`.

Do not bulk-use photography assignments, research projects, design prototypes, maps, cards, worksheets, reports, presentations, peer tests, or teacher approval as default Story engines.

## 7. Automated validation boundary + authority states

```text
Automated checks implemented:
Exact scope of each check:
Fields not evaluated by automation:
MACHINE_CONTENT_GATE:
MACHINE_SEMANTIC_GATE:
AGENT_SEMANTIC_SUFFICIENCY:
AGENT_LITERARY_REVIEW:
HUMAN_NARRATIVE_ANTI_TEMPLATE:
FOUNDER_STORY_APPROVAL:
OVERALL_STORY_QUALITY:
AUTOMATED_SCORE_USED_AS_LITERARY_APPROVAL: NO
```

`360 / 360 PASS`, `score 100`, `average 100`, `552 tests`, `Rule A = 0`, `Rule B = 0`, or `all fields present` MUST NOT be copied into `AGENT_LITERARY_REVIEW`, `FOUNDER_STORY_APPROVAL`, or `OVERALL_STORY_QUALITY` as proof.

Before explicit Founder decision, `FOUNDER_STORY_APPROVAL = PENDING`.

## 8. Founder-approved Story protection / remediation gate

```text
Existing Founder-approved Story: YES / NO
Quality debt found: YES / NO
Recommended action: KEEP / LIGHT REFINE / MAJOR REMEDIATION / REOPEN RECOMMENDED / CANDIDATE REWRITE REQUIRED
Founder authorization to change approved Story: YES / NO / NOT_APPLICABLE
Story content may be modified now: YES / NO
```

A Founder-approved Story may be audited, but quality debt does not silently authorize prose changes. If reopening is recommended, preserve the approved Story until Founder explicitly authorizes remediation.

For an unapproved Candidate, remediation may proceed only within the authorized Story scope and still follows ONE STORY AT A TIME.
